verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs say it does text-to-video generation, and its pricing lists a Text to Video SKU. For iteration, it claims creators can refine and edit videos through multiple rounds of post-production, preserve context across editable nodes, and generate from video input or in multiple versions at once. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how a prior result is reused when re-prompting (e.g., video-level region editing, since the mask editing cited is image-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the iteration workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation using diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture.
